\n          - paragraph [ref=e3172]: SEA-LION-7B-Instruct is a multilingual model for natural language understanding (NLU), natural language generation (NLG), and natural language reasoning (NLR) tasks that has been fine-tuned with thousands of English and Indonesian instruction-completion pairs alongside a smaller pool of instruction-completion pairs from other Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) languages. These instructions have been carefully curated and rewritten to ensure the model was trained on truly open, commercially permissive and high quality datasets. This model is for demonstration purposes and not-for-production usage.\n          - paragraph [ref=e3173]: SEA-LION stands for Southeast Asian Languages In One Network.\n          - heading \"Third-Party Community Consideration Skip link to Third-Party Community Consideration\" [level=2] [ref=e3174]:\n            - generic [ref=e3176]: Third-Party Community Consideration\n            - link \"Skip link to Third-Party Community Consideration\" [ref=e3177] [cursor=pointer]:\n              - /url: \"#third-party-community-consideration\"\n              - text: 
\n          - paragraph [ref=e3211]: SEA-LION-7B-Instruct was trained on a wide range of instructions that were manually and stringently verified by our team. A large portion of the effort was dedicated to ensuring that each instruction-completion pair that the model sees is of a high quality and any errors were corrected and rewritten by native speakers or else dropped from our mix.\n          - paragraph [ref=e3212]: In addition, special care was taken to ensure that the datasets used had commercially permissive licenses through verification with the original data source.\n          - heading \"Benchmark Performance Skip link to Benchmark Performance\" [level=2] [ref=e3213]:\n            - generic [ref=e3215]: Benchmark Performance\n            - link \"Skip link to Benchmark Performance\" [ref=e3216] [cursor=pointer]:\n              - /url: \"#benchmark-performance\"\n              - text:

complementary \"Note\" [ref=e243]:\n              - paragraph [ref=e244]:\n                - img [ref=e245]\n                - text: Note\n              - paragraph [ref=e248]:\n                - text: Configuration files are\n                - Settings from the following config locations are combined. Later configs override earlier ones only for conflicting keys. Non-conflicting settings from all configs are preserved.\n            - paragraph [ref=e251]:\n              - text: For example, if your global config sets\n              - code [ref=e252]: \"`autoupdate: true`\"\n              - text: and your project config sets\n              - code [ref=e253]: \"`model: \\\"anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5\\\"`\"\n              - text: \", the final configuration will include both settings.\"\n            - paragraph [ref=e257]: \"Config sources are loaded in this order (later sources override earlier ones):\"\n            - list [ref=e258]:\n              - listitem [ref=e259]:\n                - strong [ref=e260]: Remote config\n                - text: (from\n                - code [ref=e261]: \"`.well-known/opencode`\"\n                - text: ) - organizational defaults\n              - listitem [ref=e262]:\n                - strong [ref=e263]: Global config\n                - text: (\n                - code [ref=e264]: \"`~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`\"\n                - text: ) - user preferences\n              - listitem [ref=e265]:\n                - strong [ref=e266]: Custom config\n                - text: (\n                - code [ref=e267]: \"`OPENCODE_CONFIG`\"\n                - text: env var) - custom overrides\n              - listitem [ref=e268]:\n                - strong [ref=e269]: Project config\n                - text: (\n                - code [ref=e270]: \"`opencode.json`\"\n                - text: in project) - project-specific settings\n              - listitem [ref=e271]:\n                - strong [ref=e272]:\n                  - code [ref=e273]: \"`.opencode`\"\n                  - text: directories\n                - text: \"- agents, commands, plugins\"\n              - listitem [ref=e274]:\n                - strong [ref=e275]: Inline config\n                -
